items.html: And behold, here, in this place, is the place of the descent and fall of the posterior of AVI, which we said above, that descended within Atzilut itself; for even though the vessels of ZA broke, nevertheless the lights of ZA remained clothed in these posterior of the upper AVI — the whole line of Hesed of ZA in the posterior of Aba, and the whole line of Gevura clothed in the posterior of Ima. And understand this introduction very well.
